claim: Attempt to implement the entire bounded WSP-05 causal task solver using only numeric weight matrices, threshold neurons, generic local plastic writes, and a declarative recurrent execution program. The Python host may encode raw state IDs and check integrity but must not calculate the causal fingerprint, latent class, reward or policy.
world: Exact WSP-05 public 32 worlds, seeds 0..31; 12 action0 reward/transition observations then 8 action1 reward/transition observations; 4 withheld action1 rewards per world = 128 heldout tests. No new world generator or altered labels.
inputs: State and successor onehot vectors over 12 raw state IDs 1000..1011; action bit and reward bit; no class or signature feature supplied.
fixed_weights: Public fixed 4x3 binary-signature classifier on two circuit-computed action0 consequence bits and bias. Four detector rows correspond to 00,01,10,11 and are assembled numerically. Additional action gating and stack wiring programmed as numeric coefficients.
plastic_weights: T0 (12x12) action0 successor, R0 (1x12) action0 reward, C0 (1x12) observed, R1 (1x4) action1 reward per learned signature, C1 (1x4) observed signature, F (1x1) fail-closed latch; 177 writable scalars, initialized to zero. All task knowledge resides in these matrices, not Python dicts keyed by states, signatures or outcomes.
readout: x -> T0*x successor vector; R0*x first reward, R0*(T0*x) successor reward; matrix-threshold 2-bit to 4-way neural detector; R1*detector binary output. Confidence from C0*x, C0*(T0*x), C1*detector and safety latch. Entire causal inference must use weighted tensor ops.
update: Fixed generic synapse rule U <- BooleanOR(U, gate * outer(post,pre)), with action0/action1 gates derived numerically from action input; action1 signature computed from prior weight state before write. Idempotent replay; an incompatible witnessed known outcome must set numeric F to one and suppress future prediction. No gradient-based optimizer.
executor: Generic numerical network interpreter executing matrix-vector multiply, threshold, stack, product, OR-outer update, and numeric guard checks. No environment-specific Python symbolic maps, hidden labels, seed-dependent reward calculators or custom Python inference shortcuts. This is an experiment toward full weight-space programming, not proof every aspect of a general cognition architecture lives in weights.
checkpoint: Canonical versioned serialization of all plastic and fixed weight tensors, explicit circuit-program identity and SHA-256 integrity. Verify exact cold restore, no state drift on four repeated experiences and separate-world isolation.
controls: WSP-05 independent symbolic two-hop signature matcher on same raw experiences
WSP-05 fully converged 33-param trained 2-8-1 MLP on same public outcome information
metrics: 128 exact binary held-out rewards, abstention counts incorrect
all 32 cold restores, replays and isolation checks
128 confident mistakes on adversarial heldout-only reward flips before evidence
128 abstentions after one contradictory shifted heldout observation, not learning
nonzero actual synapse writes and frozen weight counts
timing, stored model bytes, committed provenance and full regression
negative: A WSP-05 alternative shifts only heldout action1 rewards, invisible in 20 public experiences. Must report confident errors before witness and fail-closed after one contradiction; no inferred unavailable labels.
engineering_gate: Exact-SHA full Windows and Linux tests including existing 54 + WSP01-05 + WSP06, frozen 32-world runner, source atlas, clean checkout; direct circuit matches 128/128 strong controls, numeric memory/weight custody verified.
science_status: Always SCIENCE_UNVERIFIED on this public authored synthetic experiment, even on perfect accuracy: strong controls tie; fixed signature construction and plastic synapse engine remain an explicit prior; unknown-world transfer and total compute parity not established.
invalid: Post-outcome source generator/seed/method/threshold/budget alteration; hidden WSP05 environment data accessed by the circuit; arbitrary Python task-specific reasoning; fake numeric weights; missing failures. Source bug repairs only after disclosure and complete requalification.
scope: Isolated WSP-06 only, read-only GitHub PR CI and generated G29 atlas exceptions. No merge, controller, schedule, research loop, live training, paid API, independent first use, or deployment.
